disclaimer: Designed PMC-OA-style methods snippets. Not a live PMC dump. Completeness is not quality.

samples.path_exercised: thoroughly reported methods section; most required fields present
samples.why_present: The high-completeness path. Cross-checks should pass.
samples.expected_behavior: Extractor fills most required fields from spans. Completeness is high. Guide matches TP53. Cell line is not on the misidentification list.

samples.path_exercised: missing guide sequence — the most common omission
samples.why_present: Nature reporting summaries still see this first. Do not invent a protospacer.
samples.expected_behavior: guide_sequence stays missing. Completeness drops. Guide-target check is skipped, not guessed.

samples.path_exercised: stated guide does not target the stated gene
samples.why_present: A complete report can still be internally inconsistent. Completeness ≠ correctness.
samples.expected_behavior: guide_sequence is filled (AATTCCCGTCGCTATCAAGG). Complementarity check FAILs against TP53. Completeness still counts the field as present.

samples.path_exercised: cell line on the committed Cellosaurus-style misidentification list
samples.why_present: INT-407 is a classic HeLa contaminant. The cross-check is the finding.
samples.expected_behavior: cell_line_or_organism = INT-407. cell_line_identity FAILs. Completeness may still be high.

samples.path_exercised: information present only as 'as previously described' — extraction must fail
samples.why_present: The extractor is forbidden to guess from a citation. Missing, not inferred.
samples.expected_behavior: Required fields stay missing. Cache quotes are empty. Completeness is low. No hallucinated gene, guide, or cell line.
